Steps for lounge space
This article is for people travelling soon

Lounge Space at the Companion Animal Travel Desk

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways helps make pet travel feel calm and manageable. If you are sorting out a trip with an animal companion, our team can guide you through the usual steps and share practical advice that fits the trip you are taking.

When you contact the desk, we start with the basic details that shape the care plan. That includes the species, the animal's temperament, and any comfort needs that matter on the day of travel. We also look at the route, the travel setup, and any handling notes that the crew should know before departure. The goal is to make the process smooth for you and steady for your pet.

Lounge space is handled with the same care. Some travelers need a quiet place to wait, while others need a little extra room to keep an animal settled and away from crowding. If lounge access is part of your trip, the desk checks the available options and shares the practical steps in plain language. We try to keep the experience simple, so you know what to expect before you arrive.

It helps to bring any details that affect comfort, such as feeding routines, calming habits, or signs that your pet prefers a quieter setting. Even small notes can make a difference, especially when the crew is preparing to support a calmer start to the journey. Clear information lets us match the plan to your pet's needs more closely.

Our team also works closely with crews so the instructions are easy to follow at the airport and on board. We keep the tone warm and professional because many travelers feel better when they know someone is paying attention to the small things. If your plans change, let us know as soon as you can so we can adjust the care plan and lounge arrangements.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways and we will walk you through the next steps.
